rows.defaultDialog: It's been... 8 years already.
It's all over, Bell-mère. 8 long years, and at last everyone is free!!
Carefully crafted, a shop a hundred years old.
This is the blacksmith. I even have the weapons Arlong banned.
I just took Nami's temperature and it's already 42 degrees! We have to find a doctor fast!
Mr. 4, take them out! Take them out! Take! Them! Out!
People without money shouldn't come to the casino anymore.
If you can't handle losing money, don't try to win it back.
What, you lost money and now you're here to make trouble?
I'm getting old, and I've seen a lot.
Nothing to do today. Let's go shopping together.
What should I buy?
Hey, have you heard? Some pirates with big bounties showed up lately.
I heard! This is our chance!
You can smell this restaurant all the way out in the street.
This is our headquarters.
I've always heard the casino owner here is a good guy.
Being driven from your home is awful.
Tch, let's lie low in Nanohana for a while.
This country is beyond saving.
Sandstorms can't destroy this resilient land.
Build a big ship! You need a big ship for the voyage!
Where did you get your perfume? It smells great.
A friend bought it in Nanohana. Let's go together next time.
Don't run off.
Come on, let's play together.
The war is finally over.
Awoo awoo!!!
You won't barge through the main gate!
Want to challenge me? No problem.
Hmm... let's have a match.
Ow... the boss won't let you get away with this!
Prepare Yourself!
I wonder if Vivi made it...
Hey! Have you seen Vivi?
Help me...
Where did Luffy run off to?
It's so hot here.
I know I can dig up water!
What I can do... right now, I just have to do what I can...!
Crocodile's lackeys...
Caw... caw caw!
That hurts!
Poor Kung-Fu Dugongs...
Sorry for the trouble. I thought you were treasure-hunting fools dreaming of finding gold too.
People's dreams never end!
The era of pirates dreaming of treasure is over.
Ha ha ha, that guy just got beaten badly by Bellamy.
Of course! He's Bellamy the Hyena, right!
Welcome to Mock Town. What'll you drink?
The front of this castle is just a board.
I've definitely heard the story of Noland the Liar.
Hey! Luffy! That's the Knock Up Stream! Th-think it over!
Luffy! If we miss this chance, who knows when we'll get to the Sky Island!
The Sky Island is scary... The Sky Island is scary...
Sounds like it'll be a fun journey.
I've never dealt with disgusting bugs in my whole life!
What's all the fuss? It's just a spider.
Gross! So disgusting!
This bird is so annoying.
What a headache.
I can't go on, I can't run anymore.
I'm worn out from running.
As long as we can see it, we're fine.
Chirp chirp... chirp chirp... chirp chirp
Welcome to Angel Beach in the land of God.
This is a Vearth, something the sky people have always longed for.
The exit is Gate 2. The huge canal that leads to "God's Island" is... is the only way through.
An unfamiliar face... Are you a pirate? I've never seen you in town.
Out of my sight, go away!
Where did the boss go...
Huh? Who do you think you are?
Don't make trouble while we're drinking, ha ha ha!
Don't look for trouble, or you'll regret it.
We were careless earlier. This time you're getting a lesson!
Ha ha, time for a brawl!
Now I'm mad. Let's fight for real!
Luffy, Zoro, don't you two cause any trouble.
You can see really far from Angel Island's lookout.
You can't escape now!
This time we're serious!
You're guilty of a crime!
It's dangerous ahead. I suggest you turn back now.
I told you... stop going forward!
These are the ruins of Jaya...
This sacred land belongs to us!
The injury was just an accident. I can keep fighting right away.
Who said you could talk down to me? Get lost!
Water Seven is great.
It's so busy here with people coming and going.
We'll work hard too. Second round of special training, let's go!
This is Water Seven's shopping street, the busiest place in town.
Ha ha, the people of Water Seven are very hospitable.
The air here is so nice.
Please, we want to get stronger!
Um... have you seen anyone drop something?
This is the last one. We'll show you what the Franky Family can do!
You're the one who sent people to attack us, aren't you?
Where did that guy run off to...
As long as you stay here, you're our enemies.
All right, offer your life to God Enel!
Say, what exactly is this Mantra?
We met a priest called Satori.
This island is actually the City of Gold!
Looks like everyone's been through a lot.
I'll definitely become a more reliable man!
Sounds like fun.
I'll never pray to God in my whole life.
This is the City of Gold we've been looking for.
This is no time to waste here.
My duty isn't done yet.
Carefully crafted, a shop a hundred years old.
Fresh fruit, come have a taste.
Cough... cough cough...
Luffy...
Luffy! I've come to take you down!
Let me lie down a bit. You're the stronger one now...
Even I failed... ha ha ha...
By God's order, I'll use the Impact Dial in my hand to deal with the Shandians and you Blue Sea dwellers.
Warrior Wyper, moving out!
Thanks for your help.
The soft, fluffy sea of clouds... I feel healed...
Want to buy some Sky Island specialties?
Watching humans here is my hobby. Want to try it too?
My kid is such a handful.
Where did that guy go...
What an interesting town.
My parents suddenly called me back to help. My date is ruined again........
Why isn't she here yet...
I'm the best craftsman on the Sky Island. There's nothing I can't fix.
I've looked everywhere and can't find it. Where did I leave it?
Hello, the weather is lovely again today.
I'm getting old and have to admit it. When I was young, I'd have finished all this in one afternoon.
Expanding this pavilion is my first job. I can't slack off.
Our shop's goods are cheap and good quality. Come take a look.
This jungle is very dangerous. I suggest you leave soon!
Lots of Blue Sea dwellers have shown up in the city lately. Don't even think about causing trouble here. I'm watching you!
Sooner or later you'll pay for taking our land!
Damn, they caught up after all!
You followed us all the way here? Then we'll have to fight!
I'm not telling you where the treasure is. Go away.
This island is called Long Ring Long Land. Welcome
Ready, Straw Hat? Let's fight!
You can't win
How foolish.
Pupu, let's begin
Leave the match to me!
There's no way you can beat me one-on-one!
Now I'm mad, you guys!
Straw Hat, you'd better remember this!
Pu, pupu
What a strange island...
Is there anyone here
Where is this place
The plants grow so strangely
The name's Foxy!
Pupu, pupupu
Those guys are so rude
Don't accept the challenge, you'll lose your crewmates.
If you lose, they take your crewmates...
If you run away, people will laugh at you.
Just win, then.
Looks scary.
So this is the "Davy Back Fight"...
Just what I wanted
If you run away, the world will laugh at you
Honestly... I have a disease that keeps me from taking part in matches...
So many people!
How could this happen...
Sounds like fun
Found some good ingredients
Nice view
This area is so empty
Whoa!
He went over toward the rocks... Is there something over there?
Who are you?
I still think you should just die here right now...
Stay back.
I won't let you...!
...do as you please any longer...!
If you want to catch me, go ahead!
I'd like to do that too, but I can't move a muscle either
Robin!
What are you doing, Usopp? Hurry and get those three...
I don't mind... but I don't have a ship to take you back, so should I just kill you?
Don't hesitate...
What are you trying to do!?
Don't go, Usopp!
After traveling together all this time, is this how we part
I see, it's badly damaged...
I'm... leaving your crew...!
Duel me!
Be careful, Miss Nami!
I never thought the ship was this badly damaged
We need to find a place to exchange the gold for cash
All right! We're off!
I missed my chance to go with them...
This area's nice
The Sky Island adventure finally paid off!
Th... three hundred million Berries!? This isn't a dream, is it!?
The shipyard is just ahead.
Let's go.
Um, we'd like to see Mr. Iceburg!
Anyway, can we go in first?
I'm the boss of this city! Iceburg.
You rude bunch!!
Please! Fix our ship! We'll pay!
Please.
Come see me again if you want to buy a ship.
Did you look at our ship for us?
If we could fit a cannon like that, the Merry could...
In this city, skill is everything
We can build similar ships, but no one can build two exactly identical ships
Tilestone in the shipyard (unused)
Even the keel is broken...
Even our skills can't fix your ship
Kaku, weren't you with the Franky Family just now?
Look at our numbers. What can just the four of you do?
Unfortunately, the money's not here anymore. Our boss, Big Bro Franky, took it to go shopping.
What a headache, we really don't know where the money went
What now? Even if we wait here for that guy, he probably won't be back soon
First aid is done
It's fine, you win
Great
Usopp before the opening (temporarily unused)
Chopper before the opening (temporarily unused)
What should we do next...
Pupu, the boss is gone.
Wait for us, boss!
Nami leaving (temporarily unused)
Robin leaving (temporarily unused)
Usopp...
Did we take a wrong turn
This should be the place Miss Nami was talking about
What are you doing
How could this be
How could you? You just said you were only here to watch!
What's your grudge against Miss Robin!
Robin is our precious crewmate now!
What exactly are you trying to say!
I'm the strongest man on this island!! The boss behind Water Seven!!!
Mr. Iceburg is awake.
Argh!!! Now I'm mad!!!
Straw Hat.
What's your goal anyway...!!! Straw Hat!!!!
Straw Hat is the Franky Family's enemy! I should be the first to settle the score with him...
Once we confirm where Mr. Iceburg's room is, we'll watch for a chance and move carefully...
You want something from me... pirate brat...
Straw Hat... Paulie...
Actually, we're spies sent by the government.
We won't meet again...
Too bad, the ship inspection result was real.
Our trained bodies can rival the hardness of steel.
Lucci, the shipwrights are coming up.
Hey! Robin, the captain never said you could leave!
Are you kidding me...
Wait, what's going on!?
Robin! We won't accept you leaving!
A rare chance. Let us show you the gap in strength.
There's no helping him... let's hurry in too!
So many guards...
The shipwrights must have gone looking for Luffy.
We misunderstood you. Sorry.
Aqua Laguna is coming!
Are you crazy! There's no way to set sail in this weather!
No matter what, we're going after Robin.
Please lend us a ship!
Damn... cough cough...
I wonder how Usopp is doing now...
Where is this!
This warehouse has been abandoned for 8 years. The Sea Train has sat here unused for 12 years
If I'm here, it means I'm thinking the same as you: we can't leave those idiots alone!
Is this train okay?
Hey, we still need to gather some essentials.
So cool!
Last night, Mr. Iceburg of the shipyard was shot!!!
Robin! Where did you go!
Robin!!
Goodbye...
Everyone should be ready...
Robin...
But to learn the truth, this is the only way
Damn! We didn't make it in time!
We missed it...
Hey, are you Nami? Someone left a little note at the station plaza... Your crewmate, right?
Is this a new weapon? Sogeking?
I'm so nervous.
Ha ha ha ha ha! So impatient!
We were so close to bringing Robin back.
Too bad, we were so close just now...
Charge into the island through the main gate in one go with this "Rocket Man"!
Charge in!!!
Sorry for blaming you earlier.
I never thought they would...
What?! Want to fight me? Bring it on!
Huh? Here to make trouble? If you want a fight, you'd better be ready!
You dare criticize what I do? You've got some nerve!
You dare order me around! I won't let you off!
I'm a proper paying customer! Don't interrupt my meal!!
No pirate is allowed to run wild on Enies Lobby!
That's Straw Hat with the 30,000,000 bounty... Can we stop him?
We have to hurry on!
I wonder if Enies Lobby's layout has changed after all this time.
Ha ha ha, you're all in a hurry.
Should we say hello first?
Are you kidding... no need.
Thanks to Luffy, the Marines are spread out too.
I'm the King of Snipers!
We have guests.
We have to catch up with Luffy fast.
You go on ahead. Leave them to me.
Oh no! They've caught up!
So this is the courthouse?
Hey, how do we open such a thick stone door!
Let's hurry and catch up with Luffy.
We have to flip the switch fast.
Let the Straw Hats charge in!
Go get 'em, boys!
Our job is to flip the switch!
And then hold the courthouse!
You again, Straw Hat.
You can't beat me! Tekkai!
If only you'd come at me like this from the start
Ow, that hurts.
Miss Robin! I've come to save you!
Hey! Zoro, be careful!
Gyababa, I won't tell you anything you ask.
The final battle is starting.
Robin's in trouble. Let's hurry and find her.
If Robin passes through that door, it's all over!
Let's hurry and find Robin.
Looks like we'll have to deal with you first.
Luffy's opponent is that pigeon guy.
Good luck, everyone
Gyababa! I'm Fukuro the Silent, and I love gossip. Do you want the key?
Too bad... looks like you're in a hurry. Go ahead, come take the key if you want it
Damn pirates!!
Are you prepared!!!
I'm pretty good with a sword too.
Switching fighters? Fine by me
Damn, the cola is right in front of me!
Nami, are you okay?
I'm fine, I got the key.
Sanji... what's wrong?
Sanji, you're too nice to women.
You say you knew Robin before?
You have the key to Robin's cuffs, right? Will you hand it over before you get beaten?
No... that won't do! This is no time for tea!
Fighters switched!
Take down the invading pirates!
You can't get past here.
Ha ha ha, Kaku, look at you!
What's so pitiful about a giraffe! I think it's pretty nice!
Is this a zoo?
What I... can do...
Watch closely! This step will be the first of a hero remembered for all time!
Hurry! Just catch Nico Robin and put her on the escort ship! Stop dawdling! The warships are coming!
I'm a man who already died once! If it lets Straw Hat and the others get out of here alive, I don't care if I lose my life!
Luffy...
We have to buy time.
If Luffy hadn't stopped the pigeon guy...
Luffy, you have to win!
Now we just have to hold on.
So glad we made it in time!
Thanks to everyone, thank you!
You guys! Wake up!
Looks like the higher-ups ordered Nico Robin taken alive.
We'll stay here and wait for Luffy.
Is Miss Nami okay?
What's with this attack?
Luffy! You've got to win!
This big ship is mine now!
Level 1 alert, prepare for battle!
It's fairly safe here, but it's dangerous inside.
Could you go help my brothers?
We need backup here!
I-I have to fight too... I can't stop shaking...
A-all forces, charge!
Cowards! Do you call yourselves Marines!
I'm fine here; the brothers over there are hurt worse...
Ugh... I can't move...
I can still help a little with healing.
Damn, if only I were stronger...
Is this the end...
Enemy spotted, prepare for battle!
Surround and wipe out enemies in numbers like this!
Just a handful of people pushed us this far... We won't let you through!
When I was shopping just now, the shopkeeper said something strange...
Huh? Who are you! Never seen you before, hey!
Finally caught up with you. Don't run!
I'm pretty confident in a test of strength.
Are you looking for a shipwright?
We're short on shipwrights...
Other people's stuff is my stuff!
Give me back my pants!!! Bastard!!!
You can't stay with us anymore. We don't want to hold you back!!
Stare...
That ship is the best ship to me and to you, but you...!! Give me back my pants!!!
Straw Hat!!!
It's my wish of many years... that's why it's a dream ship!!!
This ship is amazing... Sailing it to the end of the world is no dream!
Behold the craftsmanship of Dock 1!
Ohhh!!
It's twice as big as the Merry
What huge square sails
Whoa!
What's that flower thing on the bow?
Let me see the kitchen!
No choice, let's run for now!
This is even stronger than a cannon!
What is he trying to do...
Really?
Hey, everyone! Usopp's here!
Hey! Say something!
Hey, long-nose, what are you doing!
I thought you were on the ship...
Vice Admiral Garp...
How nostalgic...
My tangerine trees!! I thought I'd never get you back!!
I'm not going anywhere~
Franky, what are you doing here...
I went to check on the injured of the Franky Family
Hey! You all doing well!?
We're coming in!
I have something important to tell you...
The Log Pose should finish recording in two or three days
Actually, I have a favor to ask...
Did you see the wanted posters?
Big Bro...
Because you're my grandson!!! I'm giving up on catching you on this island!!!
Uh-oh, the Marines are already here!
Woof! Woof! Awoo~
This weather is so unpleasant.
No good, the Log Pose has stopped working.
So this is that legendary sea. Don't let your guard down.
Interesting...
I'm not scared...!
Evil spirits begone, evil spirits begone, evil spirits begone...
Miss Nami, if you're scared, hold on to me tight!
I am Master Hogback's servant.
Rawr!!
I'm rotten.
Me too.
Actually, my stamina is really poor.
I'm an injured old man.
I'm the legendary genius doctor!
The laboratory is off-limits!
There shouldn't be plates in this world.
Dr. Hogback's laboratory... I'd love to see it.
Nami, aren't you being too suspicious?
Everything here feels wrong...
This way, I'll take you to the bedroom...
Don't even think of setting foot out of this room!
I won't let you escape! You brats!
The treasure isn't here!
It's pure art! Only a genius like me could pull this off!
Better if it's ruined.
Gakk...
Not a single pirate gets away!
I won't betray the infamy I had in life.
A wound on the back is a swordsman's shame!
The Night of the Zombies begins!
We have to think of something fast.
What a huge spider!
Lady Perona's ghost network has found out everything about you!
I won't run away this time! I'll defeat that man for sure...
Make me the Pirate King already!
Kumashi, be quiet! You're not cute at all!
Ah, um...
Hey hey, Cindry, don't make it worse...
No one will marry you, Absalom!
Hogback! Keep your underlings in line!
Untie me now! You garlic head!
Can you understand the troubles of a genius like me?
Hogback! You don't deserve to be a doctor!
Chopper...
Leave the fight with the pirates to the General Zombies!
Gaooo!
We're immune to blades and bullets!
My boss is... Absalom the Grave Robber!
The boss... his hobby is peeping!
Beat me if you can!
Zzz... zzz... meat...
...mm... swordsman...
...beautiful woman... snore...
This is when Captain Usopp saves the day!
We met a skeleton guy, and he told us the zombies' weakness.
N... Nami... was taken away...
Horo horo~~
Negative negative~~
Horo horo~~~
You're my type! Marry me!
Are you going to help that skeleton get his shadow back?
I'm curious how strong the legendary samurai zombie really is.
Tie them up tight!
We'll give you a good beating!
We'll offer you to the master!
This is bad! Lady Perona! The pirates...
Did we lose them...?!
Probably...
Phew...
Don't underestimate me, the Ghost Princess!
Don't you touch Lady Perona!
Don't lay a finger on my crew!
Absalom is mine!
They came back again!
That new guy... aren't zombies supposed to obey orders absolutely?
I don't fight women. That's my chivalry!
Could this zombie be Sanji's...
I prefer delicate women...
Meeeat!!!
Whoa! He's going berserk!
This is a bit tricky.
So big, yet so agile...
Guaaaah!!!
Before dawn, at least get Luffy back to normal!
To be honest, I just started to feel I'm about to be wiped out...
Don't be fooled by the shadow...
Not being able to repay a kindness is too painful! I don't care if I'm smashed to pieces!
500 years ago, Oars must have gotten lost, wandered into a land of ice and frozen to death!
We've got no choice but to give it our all!
Then here goes! With my special mortar!
It's almost dawn!
Look what you've done! You've made a mess of my Thriller Bark!
I'm called a Pacifista, a humanoid weapon the government hasn't finished yet.
You're all my type!
How infuriating!
Outsmarted by a bunch of trash... how humiliating...
Miss Nami!!!
This sleeping pill works well.
It's not easy for the boss to get married! We won't let you ruin it!
What grudge do you have against our boss?!
You interrupted before I even saw the vow kiss!
Don't joke around. As if I'd hand Miss Nami over to you.
Unbelievable! I can live in the sunlight once more!
It's great to have friends...
Don't disturb Zoro's rest. He's badly hurt.
Heh heh... isn't this nice?
Ban... quet! Ban... quet! Oh! Baby!
Gahahaha...!!
I made lots of food! Don't you dare leave any!!
There are so many zombies here, I'm so scared...
We can't give up fighting!
I'll get through here and regroup with my friends!
Ah... what should I do
Woof! Woof! Awoo!
Our job is to drive off the survivors!
Hey, why aren't you running away when you see me!
I feel like... like I lost something important...
My friend seems to have lost something important. I came out to gather information.
What's this?
I can't go on, I can't run anymore. You go ahead.
If we die, we die together!
You've got nowhere left to run!
You wasted so much of my time!
Finally... finally I can see the sun!
Where... am I?
What are you doing!!
Are the zombies gone?
It should be safe to walk out now...
Thank you! In my lifetime I... I can have a shadow again...
Thanks for your hard work. Let me rest here for a while.
Want to hear a story?
I work part-time at Hatchan's takoyaki shop now. I want to be a fashion designer someday!
You sure are chatting up a storm... Aren't you forgetting someone important?
Don't come, Camie!
Catch Camie and we'll be rich, ha ha ha!
Even Hatchan, who always comes to save you, ended up like that!
You can't escape... Camie...
Luffy! Waaah!
Bastards! Let go of Camie!
Yohohoho! Music is power!
Don't forget, this is our turf!
We'll show you our speed and destructive power!
There's a woman! I hate to hit her.
Even if I have to tear this place apart, I'll get you!
The boss is so mad his accent's coming out!
Boss...
You were scared too, weren't you!
Is that my fault?!
That's just what you look like.
Yohohoho yohohoho yohohoho!
From now on, let's rename ourselves the "Pink Life Knights"!
Yes! Handsome!
Boss! You've got to listen to people!
I'm stuffed! Why is this takoyaki so good!?
Leaving? Do you know how to get to Fish-Man Island?
Robin-chan, what would you like for afternoon tea?
Sea monsters and sharks... I'm not scared at all!
Delicious!
But this ship can't dive.
I'm about to burst, I'm so happy!
What a lovely afternoon, burp...
Then, a coffee please.
Told you, right? Hatchan's takoyaki is the best in the world, right?!
Exhausting... They sure can eat. That's the Straw Hats for you!
I'll stay to guard the treasure for Miss Nami. After all, I'm a slave to love!
If you admit it yourself, I've got nothing to say.
What to do? The ship is full of treasure, and where's the knight to guard it?
This is the world's largest mangrove forest. These 79 trees make up the Sabaody Archipelago.
Don't be silly, you can't ride it, Camie!
Sabaody Park is the place I've always longed for...
Even catching one would make us rich...
You're the ones with the 300 million bounty...
My information network is quite impressive.
Huh? Are you treating me like an easy mark?
It's the first time I've seen such a rip-off.
Woman, I advise you to know your place!
Let Hatchan rest and heal here with me.
What a pain. I thought this would be easy.
I won't let you through... Brother Kizaru...
My defense is the best in the world.
If you went traveling, where would you go?
Who are you!?
Celestial Dragons... damn them!
We'll get you back!
Miss Nami, could we buy that girl too?
Camie must be so scared, right?
Waah... it's all my fault...
Compared to those greedy, power-hungry people, the bad stuff we do is child's play, right, Killer.
That's right...
Captain, they're here.
Heh heh, you've opened my eyes.
Camie! Finally found you! Thank goodness!
Mmhmm! Hmm! Mm! Octopus! Free! ♪
Call Marine HQ and the warships! Teach them a lesson!!
Guards! Come quickly!
Arrest the pirates!
You fools actually want to protect a Fish-Man!
Seems we're a bit too conspicuous.
Hurry and save little Camie!
You all know what to do, right?
You punched him away, so now I can't cut him.
Sorry I'm late... pardon me!
The key to Camie's collar must be hidden backstage!
Oh well, that's Luffy for you!
Crane!
Luffy, where's Camie?!
We've got top-grade goods today. They'd better sell high!
Don't interfere with our business. The Marines are stationed nearby!
Well, well... more of you than I expected...
How annoying. Why do I have to work with these guys...
We just have to beat the Marines, right!
An Admiral is arriving soon! I suggest you surrender now!
Everyone, careful! Cannonballs don't work on them! All three of them are Devil Fruit users!
This has been my dream since I was little... I'll never forget it! Thank you!
Nahaha! Are you crying because you're happy?
Let's ride that next!
Every mermaid and Fish-Man must have dreamed of coming here as a kid!
Yohoho, it doesn't look that tall.
Camie! You can't go in!
Daddy brought you to the amusement park today, so don't tell Mommy when we get home!
Okay, Daddy... (blushing)
Did you have fun at the amusement park today?
These three tickets cost me a month's pay...
If you two keep fighting, I'm going home... We rarely get to come to the amusement park...
What are you doing here! I was first!
How can this be! How are you so good at this!
Maybe this is the place I've always been looking for...
Remember when we first met?
Big Brother... sigh...
I'm thanking heaven you didn't bring that awful harmonica.
Hey! You there! Ask how much it costs to buy this place!
Mister... why did Daddy sneak off here?
Finally, vacation!
Big Sis! We could open a café here too!
Little Sis, let's go back and ask the boss.
How vulgar and rude!
Is this a m-man? It's the first time I've seen one...
I... I'm feeling a little strange. I should be firmly driving men out...
Get him! Take his head!
Heh heh heh... Should we swallow him whole?
Or should we strangle him?
A terrible past I'd rather not remember...
And you call yourself a pirate. You don't know anything.
I heard everything... You saved me. Thank you, Luffy!
That person... is going to be killed...
Sigh... I knew it...

rows.textModuleId: Congrats on getting new equipment! Equipment greatly boosts your characters' Power. Put it on now!

Tap Characters

Tap the equipment icon

Placeholder text

Tap Lineup
Tap Characters

Event dungeons include Secret Book Day, Breakthrough Day, Training Day, Golden Trial and Brave Trial, which give Secret Books, Breakthrough materials, Training items, Gold Bars and EXP Scrolls respectively.
The 3 dungeons Secret Book Day, Breakthrough Day and Training Day have limited attempts once open; when they run out, you can use items to add more
Tap Golden Trial
The 3 dungeons Secret Book Day, Breakthrough Day and Training Day have several difficulty levels; the higher the level, the richer the rewards.
Golden Trial and Hero Trial can be challenged with the matching key. Keys drop from the system and can also be bought in the Shop.
Once Golden Trial or Hero Trial starts, the challenge lasts 20 minutes, during which you can keep taking on higher floors for more rewards
Now try challenging an Event Dungeon, Captain!
Tap the Blacksmith
The Blacksmith refines equipment, which greatly boosts its stats. Now try it yourself, Captain!
Tap Main Quest to start your adventure!
Welcome to the Arena! It's where players show their strength. Defeat more opponents to make your name across the seas!
On the right are players ranked near you. Tap Challenge to fight them; win to swap ranks, lose and your rank stays the same
Tap the refresh button to change opponents
Prestige earned from Arena wins can be exchanged for items at the Prestige Shop.

Now pick an opponent and challenge them yourself, Captain!
Tap to open the minimap

Tap Character Stories

Now tap to open a Character Story.

Now challenge a Character Story, Captain!

Tap Events
Tap Story Replay

Now challenge a dungeon, Captain!
Congrats on your victory, Captain! You met a star condition for the first time and earned Blue Diamonds.
Story Replay dungeons drop equipment rewards, with a chance of Hero Gear
Victories use challenge attempts, which refresh daily at 0:00.
Dungeons come in Easy and Hard. Hard dungeons have stronger enemies but better rewards; team play recommended.
Now take on Story Replay dungeons yourself, Captain!

Now let's look at other features. Tap the close button

Time until all orders refresh
